ios.desc:
Visit every square exactly once with a chess knight. Knight's Graph turns the classic knight's tour into a puzzle where each move shapes the rest of your route.

CHOOSE YOUR START
Place the knight on any square and move in an L shape: two squares in one direction, then one to the side. Plan ahead to cover the board without revisiting a square.

MAKE THE CHALLENGE YOURS
• Seven board sizes: 5×5, 6×6, 8×8, 10×10, 12×12, 14×14 and 16×16
• Optional move highlighting and move numbers on the board
• Undo moves during an ongoing game
• An optional stopwatch to track your time
• Resume an unfinished game on the same board size
• Light and dark themes

Choose a starting square. How far can you go?

show_hn.title: Show HN: Knight's Graph – game based on the Knight's tour problem

quotes.text:
When I was in high school, my dad showed me how to play Knight Tour on a piece of paper. Many years passed before I decided to create the Knight's Graph app.

“Knight's Graph” is an intellectual puzzle game based on the classic knight tour problem, known since the 18th century. Your task is to move the chess knight across the board so that each square is visited exactly once. Test your logical and strategic skills in an exciting game where every game is a new challenge!

The app is already available for download on the App Store. Google Play will be available a little later.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/ru/app/knights-graph/id6737812039?l=en-GB
Website: https://knightsgraph.vercel.app
